name: Arunachal Pradesh

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Arunachal Pradesh.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Itanagar. Arunachal Pradesh covers a geographic area of 83,743 sq km across 26 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Siang (Brahmaputra), Kameng, Subansiri, Dibang, Lohit.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Known as the 'Land of Dawn-Lit Mountains', India's easternmost state bordering China, Bhutan, and Myanmar. Home to Tawang Monastery, India's largest Buddhist monastery.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Arunachal Pradesh.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Arunachal Pradesh was formally instituted on 20 February 1987. Official language(s): English.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Bardo Chham, Wancho dance, Ponung.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Losar, Torgya, Mopin, Solung.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Arunachal Pradesh.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Lt. Gen. Kaiwalya Trivikram Parnaik.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Arunachal Pradesh is Pema Khandu.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Gauhati High Court (Itanagar Permanent Bench).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Gayal (Mithun) | State Bird: Great hornbill | State Flower: Foxtail orchid | State Tree: Hollong.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Arunachal Pradesh.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Petroleum, Coal, Dolomite, Graphite.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Arunachal Pradesh plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Arunachal Pradesh.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Tawang Monastery (Galden Namgey Lhatse), Ita Fort, Jawaharlal Nehru State Museum.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Namdapha National Park, Mouling National Park, Pakke Tiger Reserve.
